name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Why here? You making a call or something? Don't you have a smartphone?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "An urban legend? Ah, right Mary-san. That Mary-san."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Hm? Mary-san, as in *that* Mary-san?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Wait, you actually met her? *That* Mary-san?!"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "She's basically a celebrity... Damn, I wanna meet her too."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What? So she basically tries to kill you? Never mind, too dangerous for me. Crazy, though."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Well, might as well try it since we're here already. But the moment things go south, we bail, got it?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah... Okay, yeah, something definitely feels weird. This place's haunted, alright."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "And? I pick up the phone, and... hm?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Look, on the ground."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What's this?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "No, seriously, what *is* this...?"
(Pick it up)
It feels kind of weird.

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "No way you're picking that up, you're unreal. That thing's already giving me the creeps."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "How do I put it? It's like... the same vibe as when you bump into a ghost. Kinda like that, but not at the same time. You get me? Nope?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Point is, it's some kinda occult thing. I think."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Is this Mary's? Did she drop it or something? Nah, can't be."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hey, maybe that occult girl would know. This kinda stuff's her specialty, right?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "If you're curious, why not ask her? I don't really care either way."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So yeah, up to you. For now, why not just take it? C'mon, let's go."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "You could just take it for now. Who knows, maybe some occult nut's gonna pay good money for it."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "If it sells, let's split—Wait, never mind. Money's useless to me."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So yeah, do whatever you want. C'mon, let's go."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "There it is, another mysterious object. So that weird feeling wasn't from the phone, but this."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Think it's cursed or something? Like, y'know, you die if you grab it, or it makes you wanna kill peeps?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But maybe you're already cursed. I'm basically already haunting you at this point. Hilarious."
(Pick it up)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So you're gonna pick it up after all? You the type who's immune to horror flicks or something? C'mon, at least be a little scared."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, whatever. Alright, let's go."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So this is what was giving off that weird vibe... It's an OOPArt, yeah?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Ah, I just realized. You're supposed to use this in some kind of ritual, right?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Maybe you can use it to summon Mary-san too... Not that I'd know."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But they're probably connected, right? I mean, they can't be totally unrelated. I think."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I wonder what comes out of the ritual. Something more famous than Mary-san, maybe? Yeah, no idea."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Maybe some ultra big shot's gonna show up if you collect 'em all. I'd kinda want to meet them."
(Pick it up)

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Alright, we've got what we came for. Time for our next stop."
